rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice when modifying something so that it fits a purpose or preference.

example.english: I want to adjust the time a little so it is more convenient for everyone.
example.traditional: 我想改吓個時間，等大家方便啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 goi2 haa5 go3 si4 gaan3 dang2 daai6 gaa1 fong1 bin6 di1

rows.note: Use this for fine-tuning settings, amounts, plans, or recipes rather than making a broad change.

example.english: Can you adjust the air-conditioning temperature a little?
example.traditional: 你可以調整吓個冷氣溫度嗎？
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 tiu4 zing2 haa5 go3 laang5 hei3 wan1 dou6 maa3

rows.note: Use this when a person or group changes their behavior or state to fit new circumstances.

example.english: After moving to a new home, it took me a few weeks to adjust.
example.traditional: 搬咗去新屋之後，我用咗幾個星期先適應到。
example.jyutping: bun1 zo2 heoi3 san1 uk1 zi1 hau6 ngo5 jung6 zo2 gei2 go3 sing1 kei4 sin1 sik1 jing3 dou2
